inheritance_rule: Nested atoms, mutations, paraphrases, and replicates inherit the parent split.

DEV.definition: Visible during development and repeatable for diagnosis or tuning.

EXTERNAL.definition: External benchmark, new dataset, or new user independent from local development.

REGRESSION.definition: Known expected answer retained to prevent recurrence of a fixed defect.

SEALED.definition: Hidden before the formal run, immutable after freeze, and unavailable for post-run tuning.
SEALED.disclosure_policy: Disclosure quarantines cases from future post-fix validation while preserving the historical run.
